verdicts.reason: A: the right column is cramped. The Shop Now button almost touches the subcopy, and the logo badge is pushed below the CTA and nearly against the bottom edge, so the brand mark comes last in the reading order. B: the reading order is clean (logo, then headline, subcopy, CTA) and there is more breathing room. But the can is shrunk and floats on the left with empty space around it, and the gap between the subcopy and the CTA is too large.

A: the headline runs nearly edge to edge and sits tight under the top. The logo badge floats on its own in the middle with no relation to anything, and the can, logo and CTA end up as three scattered pieces along the bottom. B: the text column and the can work as a tidier pair. Its flaws are a cramped CTA under the subcopy and a logo jammed near the bottom edge.

A: a clear centred vertical stack (logo, headline, subcopy, can, CTA) that suits the square format. However, the subcopy line nearly touches the side edges, the can is reduced to a small object, and the CTA sits close to the bottom. B: the logo comes after the CTA and is cramped against the bottom edge, and the CTA almost collides with the subcopy, so the hierarchy reads less cleanly than in A.
